title: HP TET JBT · November 2019 (previous year questions)
description: Questions asked in the HP TET JBT exam of the November 2019 session (held 24 November 2019), with answers checked against a published solved paper and independently verified. Not the complete paper: passage-based, garbled or doubtful questions were left out.

questions.text: √(110¼) is equal to
questions.textHi: √(110¼) बराबर है
questions.explanation: 110¼ = 441/4, and √(441/4) = 21/2 = 10.5. (Q2 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: Find the difference between 24% and 36% of Rs 475.
questions.textHi: 475 रुपये के 24% तथा 36% में अंतर ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Difference = 12% of 475 = Rs 57. (Q4 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: The price of sugar increases by 10%. By what per cent should a housewife reduce her consumption so that her expenditure does not change?
questions.textHi: चीनी का भाव 10% बढ़ गया है। एक गृहिणी चीनी की खपत में कितने प्रतिशत कमी करे कि उसका खर्च न बढ़े?
questions.explanation: Reduction = 10/(100 + 10) × 100 = 100/11 = 9 1/11%. (Q5 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-1.html
(1/64)^(−6/4) = 64^(3/2) = 8³ = 512. (Q6 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: The average of 10 numbers is 7. If each number is multiplied by 12, what will be the average of the new numbers?
questions.textHi: 10 संख्याओं का औसत 7 है। यदि प्रत्येक संख्या को 12 से गुणा करे तो नयी संख्याओं का औसत क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: Multiplying every number by 12 multiplies the average by 12: 7 × 12 = 84. (Q7 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: A's salary is 20% more than B's. By what per cent is B's salary less than A's?
questions.textHi: A का वेतन B के वेतन से 20% अधिक है, तो B का वेतन A के वेतन से कितने प्रतिशत कम है?
questions.explanation: If B = 100, A = 120; B is 20/120 × 100 = 16 2/3% less. (Q8 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: Find the average of all even numbers from 1 to 42.
questions.textHi: 1 से 42 तक की सभी सम संख्याओं का औसत ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Even numbers 2, 4, ..., 42 form an AP; average = (2 + 42)/2 = 22. (Q9 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: A person buys 12 mangoes for Rs 10 and sells them at 10 mangoes for Rs 12. What is his profit or loss per cent?
questions.textHi: कोई व्यक्ति 10 रुपये में 12 आम खरीदकर उन्हें 12 रुपये में 10 की दर से बेचता है। इस लेन-देन में उसका लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: CP of 1 mango = 10/12, SP = 12/10; profit = (1.2 − 0.833)/0.833 = 44% gain. (Q10 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-1.html

questions.text: If the cost price of 24 oranges equals the selling price of 18 oranges, find the profit per cent.
questions.textHi: यदि 24 संतरों का क्रय मूल्य 18 संतरों के विक्रय मूल्य के बराबर हो, तो लाभ प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: Profit = (24 − 18)/18 × 100 = 33 1/3%. (Q11 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: A bag contains 25 paise, 10 paise and 5 paise coins in the ratio 1 : 2 : 3. If the total amount is Rs 60, the number of 25 paise coins is
questions.textHi: एक थैले में 25 पैसे, 10 पैसे व 5 पैसे के सिक्कों का अनुपात 1 : 2 : 3 है। यदि थैले में कुल धन 60 रुपये है, तो 25 पैसे के सिक्कों की संख्या है
questions.explanation: Value per set = 25 + 20 + 15 = 60 paise; Rs 60 = 6000 paise gives 100 sets, i.e. 100 coins of 25 paise. (Q12 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: 36 people working 7 hours a day can finish a work in 32 days. How many people will be required to finish it in 24 days working 6 hours a day?
questions.textHi: 36 आदमी प्रतिदिन 7 घंटे काम करके एक काम को 32 दिन में पूरा कर सकते हैं, तो 6 घंटे प्रतिदिन काम करके उसी काम को 24 दिन में पूरा करने के लिए कितने आदमियों की आवश्यकता होगी?
questions.explanation: 36 × 7 × 32 = x × 6 × 24, so x = 8064/144 = 56. (Q13 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: In how many years will a sum double itself at 12% per annum simple interest?
questions.textHi: कितने वर्षों में कोई राशि 12% वार्षिक साधारण ब्याज की दर से दुगुनी हो जाएगी?
questions.explanation: Doubling means SI = P: T = 100/12 = 8 1/3 years. (Q14 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: A sum becomes three times itself in 10 years at simple interest. In how many years will it become seven times?
questions.textHi: कोई धन साधारण ब्याज पर 10 वर्षों में तीन गुना हो जाता है। वह कितने वर्षों में सात गुना हो जाएगा?
questions.explanation: Tripling: SI = 2P in 10 years, so rate = 20%; seven times needs SI = 6P, i.e. 30 years. (Q15 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: The sum of the first n natural numbers is
questions.textHi: प्रथम n प्राकृत संख्याओं का योग है
questions.explanation: 1 + 2 + ... + n = n(n + 1)/2. (Q16 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: If x + 1/x = 5, then the value of x² + 1/x² is
questions.textHi: यदि x + 1/x = 5 हो, तो x² + 1/x² का मान होगा
questions.explanation: x² + 1/x² = (x + 1/x)² − 2 = 25 − 2 = 23. (Q17 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: The solutions of the equation x² − 7x + 12 = 0 are
questions.textHi: समीकरण x² − 7x + 12 = 0 के हल हैं
questions.explanation: x² − 7x + 12 = (x − 3)(x − 4) = 0, so x = 3 or 4. (Q18 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: What should be added to a³ + b³ − 3ab to get 3a³ + 4b³ + 4c³?
questions.textHi: a³ + b³ − 3ab में क्या जोड़ें कि 3a³ + 4b³ + 4c³ प्राप्त हो?
questions.explanation: (3a³ + 4b³ + 4c³) − (a³ + b³ − 3ab) = 2a³ + 3b³ + 4c³ + 3ab. (Q19 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: Divide 12 − 14x² − 13x by 2x + 3.
questions.explanation: (2x + 3)(−7x + 4) = −14x² + 8x − 21x + 12 = −14x² − 13x + 12. (Q20 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-2.html

questions.text: Simplify: (3⁰ − 5⁰) × (3⁰ − 5⁰)
questions.textHi: सरल कीजिए: (3⁰ − 5⁰) × (3⁰ − 5⁰)
questions.explanation: 3⁰ = 5⁰ = 1, so (1 − 1) × (1 − 1) = 0. (Q21 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: The cost of 8 dozen bananas is Rs 180. How many bananas can be bought for Rs 30?
questions.textHi: 8 दर्जन केलों का मूल्य 180 रु. है। रु. 30 में कितने केले खरीदे जाएंगे?
questions.explanation: 8 dozen = 96 bananas for Rs 180; Rs 30 buys 96 × 30/180 = 16. (Q22 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: A 135 m long train is moving at 54 km/h. How much time will it take to pass a telegraph pole?
questions.textHi: 135 मीटर लम्बी एक रेलगाड़ी 54 किमी/घंटा की चाल से चल रही है। यह एक टेलीग्राफ के खम्भे को पार करने में कितना समय लेगी?
questions.explanation: 54 km/h = 15 m/s; time = 135/15 = 9 s. (Q23 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: The ratio of the present ages of Daya and her daughter is 4 : 1. After 4 years it will be 14 : 5. What is the present age of the daughter?
questions.textHi: दया और उसकी पुत्री की वर्तमान आयु का अनुपात 4 : 1 है। 4 वर्ष बाद यह अनुपात 14 : 5 हो जाएगा। पुत्री की वर्तमान आयु कितनी है?
questions.explanation: (4x + 4)/(x + 4) = 14/5 gives 20x + 20 = 14x + 56, so x = 6 years. (Q24 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: a³ − b³ is equal to
questions.textHi: a³ − b³ बराबर है
questions.explanation: (a − b)³ = a³ − b³ − 3ab(a − b), so a³ − b³ = (a − b)³ + 3ab(a − b). (Q25 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Find the largest five-digit number which is exactly divisible by 91.
questions.textHi: 5 अंकों की सबसे बड़ी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जो 91 से पूर्णतः विभाज्य हो।
questions.explanation: 99999 = 91 × 1098 + 81, so the largest multiple is 99999 − 81 = 99918. (Q26 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: The total number of prime numbers between 1 and 100 is
questions.textHi: 1 से 100 के बीच अभाज्य संख्याओं की कुल संख्या है
questions.explanation: There are 25 prime numbers between 1 and 100. (Q27 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Find the largest four-digit number which, when divided by 12, 18 and 35, leaves remainder 5 every time.
questions.textHi: चार अंकों की सबसे बड़ी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जिसे 12, 18 तथा 35 से भाग देने पर हर बार 5 शेष बचे।
questions.explanation: LCM(12, 18, 35) = 1260; largest four-digit multiple = 8820; add remainder 5 to get 8825. (Q28 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Four bells ring at intervals of 3, 7, 12 and 14 minutes. If they start ringing together at 10 a.m., when will they next ring together?
questions.textHi: चार घंटियाँ क्रमशः 3, 7, 12 तथा 14 मिनट के अंतराल पर बजती हैं। यदि वे प्रातः 10 बजे एक साथ बजना आरम्भ करें, तो पुनः कब एक साथ बजेंगी?
questions.explanation: LCM(3, 7, 12, 14) = 84 minutes = 1 h 24 min after 10 a.m., i.e. 11:24 a.m. (Q29 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: What is the LCM of 1/3, 2/9, 5/6 and 4/27?
questions.textHi: 1/3, 2/9, 5/6 और 4/27 का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य क्या होगा?
questions.explanation: LCM of fractions = LCM of numerators / HCF of denominators = LCM(1, 2, 5, 4)/HCF(3, 9, 6, 27) = 20/3. (Q30 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-3.html

questions.text: Fill in the blank with the appropriate conjunction: Catch me ________ you can.
questions.explanation: "Catch me if you can" uses the conditional conjunction "if". (Q31 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to: WORST
questions.explanation: Best is the opposite of worst. (Q33 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to: DISSATISFIED
questions.explanation: Satisfied is the opposite of dissatisfied. (Q34 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the word nearest in meaning to: DIGNITY
questions.explanation: Dignity means honour or glory. (Q35 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the synonym of 'passion' in: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam did the job with great passion.
questions.explanation: Passion here means zeal, strong enthusiasm. (Q36 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-4.html

questions.text: Change into indirect speech: She said to me, 'Would you open the door, please?'
options: She asked me to please open the door.
She requested me to open the door.
She requested me to please open the door.
She asked me to keep the door opened.
questions.explanation: A polite request is reported with "requested": She requested me to open the door. (Q47 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Change into indirect speech: They said, "We have lived here for a long time."
options: They said they have been living there for a long time.
They said they lived here for a long time.
They said that they had lived there for a long time.
They said they have lived for a long time.
questions.explanation: Present perfect becomes past perfect and "here" becomes "there". (Q48 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to 'austere': The artist led a very austere life.
questions.explanation: Austere (simple, without comfort) is the opposite of luxurious. (Q51 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to 'penchant': He has a penchant for satirical writing.
questions.explanation: A penchant is a strong liking; its opposite is dislike. (Q52 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to 'turbid': He plunged into the turbid water of the stream.
questions.explanation: Turbid (muddy, cloudy) is the opposite of clear. (Q53 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to 'obscure': An obscure traveller was found dead on the road.
questions.explanation: Obscure (unknown) is the opposite of famous. (Q54 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to 'pragmatic': Only a pragmatic approach to these problems can solve them.
questions.explanation: Pragmatic (practical, realistic) is opposite to idealistic. (Q55 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Fill in the blank: The poet and novelist ________ dead.
questions.explanation: One article before both nouns means one person, so the verb is singular: is. (Q57 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Fill in the blank: Honesty is the ________ policy.
questions.explanation: The proverb is "Honesty is the best policy". (Q58 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Fill in the blank with the appropriate conjunction: He will not come ________ it rains.
questions.explanation: "If" introduces the condition: He will not come if it rains. (Q59 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: Fill in the blank with the appropriate conjunction: He is very rich ________ he is not happy.
questions.explanation: "Yet" shows contrast: He is very rich, yet he is not happy. (Q60 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-6.html

questions.text: बलाघात से क्या तात्पर्य है?
options: किसी खास शब्द या वर्ण पर बल देना
questions.explanation: बलाघात का अर्थ है उच्चारण में किसी शब्द या वर्ण पर विशेष बल देना। (Q61 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: 'क्षणिक' का विलोम है:
questions.explanation: 'क्षणिक' (थोड़ी देर का) का विलोम 'शाश्वत' (सदा रहने वाला) है। (Q62 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: 'वृक्ष से फल गिरा।' वाक्य में कौन-सा कारक प्रयुक्त हुआ है?
questions.explanation: 'से' अलग होने का भाव बता रहा है, अतः अपादान कारक। (Q63 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: 'मना' की भाववाचक संज्ञा है:
questions.explanation: 'मना' से भाववाचक संज्ञा 'मनाही' बनती है। (Q64 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द: गुरु के समीप अथवा साथ रहने वाला
questions.explanation: गुरु के समीप रहकर पढ़ने वाला शिष्य अंतेवासी कहलाता है। (Q65 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: 'चरण-कमल बंदौं हरि राई' पंक्ति में कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.explanation: 'चरण-कमल' में चरणों पर कमल का अभेद आरोप है, अतः रूपक अलंकार। (Q66 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: 'आजकल विभीषणों की कोई कमी नहीं है।' वाक्य में 'विभीषणों' कौन-सी संज्ञा है?
questions.explanation: 'विभीषण' व्यक्तिवाचक संज्ञा है, पर यहाँ 'विश्वासघाती लोगों' के वर्ग के अर्थ में प्रयुक्त होने से जातिवाचक है। (Q67 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: 'कागा काको धन हरै, कोयल काको देय। मीठे वचन सुनाय कर, जग अपनो कर लेय॥' इन पंक्तियों में कौन-सा छन्द है?
questions.explanation: पहले-तीसरे चरण में 13 और दूसरे-चौथे में 11 मात्राएँ होने से यह दोहा छंद है। (Q68 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: अपने कथन की ________ प्रमाणित कीजिए।
questions.explanation: कथन की सत्यता प्रमाणित की जाती है। (Q69 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: क्रिया के मूल रूप को क्या कहते हैं?
questions.explanation: क्रिया का मूल रूप धातु कहलाता है, जैसे पढ़, लिख। (Q70 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-7.html

questions.text: 'चाय' किस भाषा का शब्द है?

questions.textHi: एक बालक की बुद्धि-लब्धि 150 है, वह बालक क्या कहलाएगा?
questions.explanation: On Terman's scale an IQ of 140 and above is genius. (Q142 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: Who first gave the concept of intelligence quotient in 1912?
questions.textHi: 1912 में सर्वप्रथम बुद्धि-लब्धि का सम्प्रत्यय किसने दिया?
questions.explanation: William Stern proposed the intelligence quotient (MA/CA) in 1912. (Q143 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: What are psychophysical differences between people called?
questions.textHi: व्यक्तियों के बीच मनोशारीरिक असमानताओं को क्या कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Psychophysical differences among people are individual differences. (Q144 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: In which type of memory can information be stored for a maximum of about 20 to 30 seconds?
questions.textHi: किस स्मृति में सूचनाओं को अधिकतम लगभग 20-30 सेकंड तक संचित रखा जा सकता है?
questions.explanation: Short-term memory holds information for about 20–30 seconds. (Q145 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: Erikson's psychosocial theory has ........ stages.
questions.textHi: एरिक्सन के मनोसामाजिक सिद्धांत में ........ सोपान हैं।
questions.explanation: Erikson proposed eight psychosocial stages. (Q146 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: The principle of classical conditioning was given by
questions.textHi: प्राचीन (शास्त्रीय) अनुबंधन का सिद्धांत किसने प्रतिपादित किया?
questions.explanation: Ivan Pavlov gave classical conditioning. (Q148 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-15.html

questions.text: According to Terman, the IQ of an average person lies between
questions.textHi: टर्मन के अनुसार सामान्य व्यक्ति की बुद्धि-लब्धि होती है
questions.explanation: On Terman's classification, average IQ is 90–110. (Q150 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-jbt-tet-nov-2019-paper-part-15.html
